title: Phase10PassiveAggressionAnnotationRecord
description: Versioned JSON schema for automated LLM-based passive-aggression annotation, auditing, and silver dataset creation.

source_dataset.description: Source dataset name (e.g. mustard, civil_comments, mmsd, sarcnet)

source_record_id.description: Original record ID in source manifest

caption.description: Associated post caption or context statement if available

image_path.description: Relative path to associated media file if present

confidence_band.description: Model-reported subjective confidence band (not calibrated probability)

evidence_spans.description: List of exact substring spans demonstrating passive-aggression markers

interpersonal_target_present.description: Prong 1: Target is an identifiable individual, participant, or group

plausible_deniability_present.description: Prong 2: Hostility is indirect or disguised, permitting denial of malice

covert_hostility_present.description: Prong 3: Hostility, blame, or resentment is present beneath surface

context_sufficient.description: True if available context is adequate for a reliable classification

image_assessed.description: True if an image was directly processed by a vision encoder during annotation

ocr_assessed.description: True if embedded image OCR text was supplied during annotation

annotation_model.description: Model identifier used for generation (e.g. llama3.2:latest)

prompt_version.description: Version string of system prompt and instructions

annotation_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of annotation generation

exclusion_reason.description: Reason for exclusion if record was rejected by silver acceptance filter

annotation_warnings.description: Warnings regarding missing context, text-only assumption, or borderline boundaries
